unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
network: The backend is unavailable. Start FastAPI on port 8000 and try again.
invalid_response: The server returned an invalid response. Please try again.
request_failed: The request failed (HTTP {{status}}). Please try again.
invalid_experiment: The experiment is invalid. Check the graph, scattering matrices and initial state.
cycle_size: A simple cycle requires at least 3 vertices.
edge_limit: The interactive API supports at most {{limit}} directed edges. Reduce the graph size or use the Python core.
matrix_vertices: Provide exactly one scattering matrix for every vertex, using the vertex labels as keys.
matrix_shape: The matrix at vertex {{vertex}} must contain rectangular rows of [real, imaginary] pairs.
matrix_dimension: The scattering matrix at vertex {{vertex}} must have dimensions {{degree}} × {{degree}}.
matrix_not_unitary: The scattering matrix at vertex {{vertex}} must be unitary: S†S = I within a tolerance of 1e-10.
hadamard_degree: Hadamard scattering requires degree 2; the selected vertex has degree {{degree}}.
density_budget: This dense reference simulation is too large for the interactive API. Reduce the graph size or number of steps, or use the Python core.
invalid_edge: The directed edge |{{target}},{{source}}⟩ ({{source}} → {{target}}) does not belong to this graph.

validation.integer: Enter an integer; decimal numbers, strings and booleans are not accepted.
validation.minimum: The value must be at least {{minimum}}.
validation.maximum: The value must be at most {{maximum}}.
validation.unsupported_value: Select one of the supported values.
validation.invalid_json: The request must contain valid JSON.
validation.invalid_structure: The data has an invalid structure or number of entries.

initial_state: The initial state must have the correct dimension, finite entries and unit normalization. Density matrices must be Hermitian and positive semidefinite.
vertex_parameters: Provide normalized boundary vectors in the stored neighbor order and a finite real phase for every vertex.
ensemble_budget: This ensemble exceeds the interactive work budget. Reduce trajectories or steps, or select the optimized strategy.
ensemble_histories: The number of selected histories cannot exceed the number of trajectories.
atom_id: Select an atom in the current model basis.
analysis_budget: Dense state and transition inspection supports dimensions up to 64. Use a smaller graph or the Python API.
stationary_budget: This analysis exceeds 250000 state-time entries. Reduce the graph size or number of reduced transitions.
stationary_class: Select a recurrent class from the current analysis.
stationary_tolerance: Enter a finite support cutoff between 0 and 1e-6.
statistics_budget: This trajectory exceeds the statistics work budget. Reduce graph size, observations or warm-up.
statistics_observable_budget: Dense Hermitian observables support dimensions up to 64. Select a label or vertex observable, or use a smaller graph.
statistics_observable: Check the observable: valid labels, distinct coherence indices, finite real values, or a finite Hermitian matrix of the correct dimension are required.
statistics_analysis: Statistical analysis failed numerical validation. Check the observable scale and support diagnostics; inspect the Python API for detailed numerical diagnostics.
custom_graph: Provide a connected, simple, loopless graph with distinct vertex IDs and valid edge endpoints.
graph_ports: Stored neighbors must exactly match the ascending stable-ID order for every vertex. No port order is changed silently.
custom_matrix: Provide a finite square unitary matrix of the current degree. Tolerance: max |S†S − I| ≤ 1e-10.
experiment_document: Invalid experiment file. Use sqw-experiment version 1 with matching graph, presentation data, matrices and initial state. The current experiment was retained.
experiment_size: The experiment file exceeds the 2 MB import limit.
